of.needed: whether the static configuration file (YAML/TOML) contains a pilot section

original.statement: Traefik Pilot static configuration (e.g. pilot.token) is no longer supported in v3 and prevents Traefik from starting; it must be removed from the static configuration.

decision.reason: [ev-9f3bf592e4e8] says any Pilot configuration in the static configuration is now unsupported and stops Traefik from starting. Its examples show this configuration as `--pilot.token` on the command line or as a `pilot` section in a YAML/TOML file. The proposed exposure covers both: it checks the CLI flag directly, and it marks the file case as undecidable because a static config file is not visible. One limit: the flag check names only `--pilot.token`, the one key the evidence shows. Other Pilot keys are not covered by that check, which is why my confidence is low.
